diagnostics.message: Telo.Library/Bindings: `at: /label` names neither a reference slot of Self.Node nor a key `match` requires; point it at the `!ref` or inline declaration the node holds, and require that key in `match`.

Telo.Library/Bindings: `copy:` source `data#/content` reads the binding `data`, which no `resolve:` entry of this rule declares; declare it under `resolve:`, or copy from the matched node with a pointer.
Telo.Library/Bindings: `move:` source `source#/content` reads a binding, and a rule writes only its own node; carry the value with `copy:` instead.
